trustInfo.name: ARUTPERUNJOTHI SEVA CHARITABLE TRUST
trustInfo.tagline: Transforming Rural Education & Community Welfare Through Transparent Service
trustInfo.registeredOffice: No. 42, Gandhi Salai, Perundurai Road, Erode - 638011, Tamil Nadu

initiatives.title: 36 Govt-Aided Schools Sanitation & Food-Beverage Infrastructure
initiatives.description: Comprehensive construction of modern, dignified toilet complexes with running water and hygienic mid-day meal / dining sheds across 36 government and rural aided schools.

initiatives.title: Rural Clean Drinking Water & Solar RO Plant Installation
initiatives.description: Installing solar-powered multi-stage RO water treatment plants providing 1,000 LPH clean fluorosis-free drinking water to rural hamlets.

initiatives.title: Nutritious Food & Grocery Kits for Destitute & Senior Citizens
initiatives.description: Monthly provision of essential foodgrains, pulses, and protein supplements to abandoned elderly and underprivileged families.

initiatives.title: Free Rural Healthcare & Cataract Eye Surgery Camps
initiatives.description: Conducting free bi-weekly rural diagnostic camps, medicine distribution, and sponsoring 100% free cataract microsurgeries with intraocular lens implants.

initiatives.title: Women Livelihood & Vocational Sewing Training Centers
initiatives.description: Establishing free motorized sewing centers in rural panchayats, training underprivileged women in tailoring and apparel stitching, with free sewing machines given on graduation.

initiatives.title: Emergency Rural Disaster & Climate Relief Fund
initiatives.description: Dedicated emergency contingency reserve for flood relief, winter blanket drives for homeless, agricultural drought assistance, and livestock veterinary care.
